references.text: The Israelites set out from the Wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud stopped in the Wilderness of Paran, the same place from which Moses sent the spies.
The people departed from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran, which was the starting point for the mission of the spies.
The Lord spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, showing the pattern where Moses acted 'at the Lord's command'.
The list of tribal leaders who were to assist Moses, parallel to how the spies were also 'heads of the children of Israel'.
Moses recounts the event where he sent twelve men, one from each tribe, to scout out the land.
The principle of choosing capable men as leaders among the people, just as the spies were heads over their tribes.
Joshua also sent spies, a parallel to Moses who sent out spies at the Lord's command.
